rooms.name: Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc:
This is the immortal enterance way into Kir Oshi.  There is a sign on the wall
that look like it may be a road map.

rooms.name: The Altar
rooms.desc:
This room is almost completely filled by a huge altar that has been
constructed to worship the gods.  You can tell that this place is
well respected because pilgrims leave money and other offering here
without fear that thieves will take them.  Behind the altar there
is a giant mosaic of a dragon flying through the clouds.

rooms.name: A Meditation Room
rooms.desc:
This room is simple, undecorated except for the few colored lanterns that
hang from the ceiling.  The purpose of this room is clear, to facilitate the
ancient art of Zanzen, the meditation.

rooms.name: The Temple Common Area
rooms.desc:
This is a large room with a vaulted ceiling, kept clean and spartan by
the monks that live here.  Travellers and students from abroad are resting
and loitering about, hoping to catch a bit of wisdom, but mostly taking in
the spectacular beauty and simplicity of this place.
   The entrance of the temple is to the south, while all other directions
lead to the internal sections of the temple.

rooms.name: The Alms Room
rooms.desc:
This is a place for those adventurers who have to give to those who are less
fortunate.  Please keep in mind the ones who don't have anything, not even
enough to stay alive.

rooms.name: Corner of Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
Here is the corner of the great wall of Kir Oshi.  From here you can proceed
east along the north face of the wall, south along the west face, or down onto
the ground level of the town.

rooms.name: North Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of a battlement along the north wall.  You have a commanding
view of all the suroundings toward the north.  Off in the distance is a steaming
volcano.  The wall continues east and to the west is the north-west corner.

rooms.name: North Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of a battlement along the north wall.  You have a commanding
view of all the suroundings toward the north.  Off in the distance is a steaming
volcano.  The wall continues to the west and to the east is the north-east
corner.

rooms.name: Corner of Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east corner of the great wall of Kir Oshi.  From here you can
go down to the ground level, head west along the north face of the wall, or go
south along the east wall.

rooms.name: Road to Temple
rooms.desc:
This is a small, winding road that leads from the city of Kir Oshi up to the
temple.  The pagoda itself sits on a small cliff overlooking the city.
The trail to the north leads right up to its gates.

rooms.name: West Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the battlement along the west wall.  From here you have a
commanding view of all the surroundings.  To the north is the north-west corner
tower.  South of here is the tower above the west gate.

rooms.name: East Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the battlement along the east wall. From here you have a
commanding view of all the surroundings.  To the east is the temple gardens,
you wonder why they are separate from the temple itself.  You can go to the
north-east guard tower or further along the east wall.

rooms.name: North-West Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
This is one of the four corner towers within the Kir Oshi wall.  The walkway
along the wall is up from here.  The wall road goes east and south from here.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
To your north is the great protective wall.  This road along the wall continues
east and west.  To your west is the North-West guard tower.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
The tall face of the northern wall looms over you here.  This road continues
both east and west along the wall.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
You are walking along the protective wall of Kir Oshi.  This is the western
side of the northern wall.  To your east is the north gate and the road
continues along the wall to the west.

rooms.name: The North Gate
rooms.desc:
This is the north gate of Kir Oshi.  Above you runs a great defensive wall,
although there is no way up to it from here.  A road heads east and west along
the wall, and south into the city.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the northern edge of Kir Oshi.  Directly to your north is the great
wall.  You can go east further along the wall, or west.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the road along the north wall in Kir Oshi.  You can continue east or
west along the north road.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the north-eastern corner of the wall surrounding the city. This 
street continues along the wall east or enters a guard tower to the west.

rooms.name: North East Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
The north-east end corner of the wall around Kir Oshi.  You can reach the walk
way on the wall by going up from here.  The wall road continues west and south.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
This is a very peaceful place.  The plants are well taken care of here.
Someone cares about the way this place looks.  The path continues south and
east.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
The is a T in the garden pathways.  There is a small nook of a garden to the
south, while the main path continues east and west.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
There is a curve in the path here.  The path goes east and south from here. You
see a small building to the southeast.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the northern side of the west wall.  To your north is a guard tower and
to the south is the west gate.

rooms.name: A Baker's Shop
rooms.desc:
All around you are the smells of a sweets shop.  Breads, rolls, and pastries
surround you.  There is a small sign on the wall.

rooms.name: A Flower Shop
rooms.desc:
It looks like spring here.  There are a huge number of flowers and other plants
here.  The smell of a great spring overwhelms you.  There is a small sign on
the wall here.

rooms.name: A Weaponsmith's Shop
rooms.desc:
This is a spotlessly clean shop.  There are weapons from famous battles all over
the place.  There is a large assortment of weapons for sale on display behind
the counter.  A small sign hangs on the wall.

rooms.name: Kero Row
rooms.desc:
This medium-sized road runs flush up to the northern city gates just
ahead of you and south into the center of Kir Oshi.  It looks like it
is well used, though it lacks the bustle of the pier.

rooms.name: Inside the Hsing-Hock'win
rooms.desc:
You stand inside the lobby of what apparently passes for accomedations in this
strange culture.  The living conditions are certainly spartan, I wouldn't be
expecting any room service if I were you.  There are, however, several nefarious
looking gentlement lounging around in the lobby, perhaps you could make some
new friends?

rooms.name: An Armorer
rooms.desc:
This is a small sheltered shop.  All around you are the gleaming metals of
protective gear.  On the wall is a small framed note.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
You are just north of the east gate, standing on a road which follows the
course of the wall. Just west of here lies the bank of Kir Oshi.

rooms.name: A Nook Garden
rooms.desc:
This a a very small clearing here.  It is very peaceful.  The main path is to
the north.  There is a small bench here.

rooms.name: West Gate Wall Tower
rooms.desc:
This is the main watch tower for the west facing wall.  From here you can
look far into the distance to see approching enemies.  You can north or south
along the west wall or go down into the the west gate.

rooms.name: East Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
You are over the east gate.  From here you can look into the temple gardens to
the east, into town to the west.  From here you can go down into the east gate,
north along the east wall, or south also along the east wall.

rooms.name: Before the Temple
rooms.desc:
You stand in front of the temple of Kir Oshi, which is located on a small cliff
overlooking the city.  From here, you have a rather panoramic view of Kir Oshi
and the surrounding countryside. Not to mention the ocean that stretches away
towards the horizon.  The view from the top of the pagoda must be spectacular.

rooms.name: The West Gate
rooms.desc:
Here is the main gate into Kir Oshi.  Above you is a great wall, which can be
reached by a set of stairs here.  West of here is the main road into town. To
the east is Yokki Way, the main commercial street of Kir Oshi. A road leads
north and south along the wall.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is the main commerce street of Kir Oshi.  To your north is a baker.  A 
tough looking tavern is to the south.  West from here is the west gate, and
Yokki Way continues to the east.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is the main commerce street of Kir Oshi.  There is a flower shop to your
north and Yokki Way continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is just west of the center of Kir Oshi.  To your north is a dealer in 
weapons and the famous Guiee's is to your south.  Just east of here is the 
market square.  You can head west along Yokki Way toward the west gate.

rooms.name: Market Square
rooms.desc:
Here is the central part of Kir Oshi.  From here you can head north or south
along Kero Row or east/west along Yokki Way.  Towering above you is a huge 
statue.  There is a plaque on the base of the statue.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is just east of the center of Kir Oshi.  Just north of here is a very nice
looking inn.  To the south is a strange store, a sign that has the word 
"Imports" hangs above the door there.  To the west is Market Square, or you can
continue east toward the east gate.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
You are on a major commerce street in Kir Oshi, although this section does not
look very nice.  You can go east or west along Yokki Way or go south into a
empty, abandoned warehouse.  There is a sign to the south partially blocking
the doorway.  There is some rope still crossing the door, but that seems to 
have fallen down a bit.

rooms.name: Yokki Way
rooms.desc:
This is the major road of Kir Oshi.  To your east is the East Gate and Yokki 
Way continues to the west.  North of you is an armorer and to the south is
another dark shop.

rooms.name: The East Gate
rooms.desc:
Here is the main east gate of Kir Oshi.  Above you is a great wall that can be
reached by a set of stairs here.  A road leads north and south along the wall.
To the west is Yokki Way, the main commerce street of Kir Oshi.  The temple
gardens are to the east.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
This is the entrance to the temple garden.  The main east gate is just west
of here. The path through the garden leads north and south.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
Here is a small clearing in the garden.  The path heads north and south from
here.  There is a small building to the east.

rooms.name: A Small Temple
rooms.desc:
This is a small stone structure on the eastern edge of the gardens,
a place for quiet reflection and perhaps prayer. In fact, there
is a wooden kneeler here for that very purpose.
The garden continues to the west.

rooms.name: Bars Crossed Tavern
rooms.desc:
This is a dark, mean looking tavern.  It looks like it is frequented by the
less-than-outstanding citizens, although the drinks probably won't be watered
down.  A small sign hangs next to the bar.

rooms.name: Guiee's Sushi Bar
rooms.desc:
This is a traditional sushi bar.  The smell of fish permeates the air here.
All around are the tasty fish treats you can order.  There is a large painted
sign hanging over the chopping block/counter.

rooms.name: An Imported Goods Store
rooms.desc:
This is a very strange store. All around you are fashions and other items
from far away lands. There is a piece of paper taped to the counter here.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Warehouse
rooms.desc:
This place looks like it was once a thriving business.  But something has gone
very wrong.  Looks like it might have been fire.

rooms.name: A Dark Building
rooms.desc:
This dark building is one of the strangest shops you've ever seen. Crude
drawings line the wall, all of them about the size of your fist: tattoos.
The tattooist sees you and says, "Be not fooled by the lack of detail;
the magick is strong."

rooms.name: A Nook Garden
rooms.desc:
This a a very small clearing here.  It is very peaceful.  The main path is too
the south.  There is a small bench here.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the southern side of the west wall.  To your south is a guard tower and
to the north is the west gate.

rooms.name: Weights and Measures
rooms.desc:
This small, busy office houses the Kir-Oshi office of weights
and measures, which takes care of all of the cities bookkeeping.
There are papers and permits for all kinds of regulated activities
here, and the stack of completed forms are arranged haphazardly
in a pile.
A small sign hangs on the wall.

rooms.name: Kero Row
rooms.desc:
This is the main north-south road in Kir-Oshi.  It is not as big or as
busy as Yokki Way, but most of its traffic tends to come from the pier.
To the north is the market square, to the west is a small, dimly lit
curio shop.  The side wall of a building blocks your way to the east.
To the south is the massive pier gate of Kir-Oshi.

rooms.name: A Secret Reception
rooms.desc:
Oops! Looks like you've stumbled onto the secret headquarters of the infamous
Liu'she Ch'uan tong. These guys don't look so friendly, maybe you should
get out of here before they get any weird ideas.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is near the south-east corner of the wall.  To the north is the east gate.
South of here is the south-east tower.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
This is a very peaceful place.  The plants are well taken care of here.
Someone spends a lot of time taking care of this place.  The path leads north
and east.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
Here is a T in the pathways.  To the north is a small nook within the garden.
The path also leads east and west.

rooms.name: The Temple Garden
rooms.desc:
There is a bend in the garden here.  The path leads both west and north.  There
is a small building to the northeast.

rooms.name: South-West Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
This is one of the four corner towers within the Kir Oshi wall system.  From
here you can proceed east or north along the wall, or you can go up to the
walkway on the wall itself.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
To your south is the great protective wall.  This road along the wall continues
to the east or west to the south-west corner.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
The wall to your south towers over you.  This road along the base of the wall
continues both east and west.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
You are on the western side of the south gate just east of here along the wall
surrounding Kir Oshi.  The road continues along the wall to the west.

rooms.name: The South Gate
rooms.desc:
You stand inside the massive southern gate of Kir Oshi. Above you is a great
defensive wall, but you can not get up on it from here. A wide, paved road
runs south to the bustling pier, and a road runs east and west along the inside
wall of the city.  Kero Row leads north into the cities central area.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
This is the southern edge of Kir Oshi.  To your west is the south gate and the
road along the wall continues east.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
To your north is the great wall surrounding Kir Oshi.  The road along this wall
goes both east and west from here.

rooms.name: Road Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
You are on a road along the south wall in Kir Oshi.  To your east is the south-
east guard tower.  The road along the wall continues west.

rooms.name: South-East Guard Tower
rooms.desc:
This is the most south-east portion of the wall surrounding Kir Oshi.  From
here you can go up to the wall walkway or you can go along the wall either 
north or west.

rooms.name: West Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the battlement along the west wall.  From here you have a
commanding view of the entire city as well as the surrounding territory.
To the north is the West Gate Wall Tower.  The southwest corner of the
battlement is just to your south.

rooms.name: East Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of the battlement along the east wall.  From here you have a
commanding view of all the surroundings.  To the north is the East Gate Wall
Tower.  And to the west is south-east corner of the wall.

rooms.name: Corner of Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
Here is the corner of the great wall of Kir Oshi.  From here you can proceed
east along the south face of the wall, north along the west face, or down onto
the ground level of the town.

rooms.name: South Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of a battlement along the south wall.  You have a commanding
view of all the suroundings toward the south.  Off in the distance is the 
Kir Oshi pier, reaching into the harbor.  The wall continues to the east and
the south-west corner is just to the west.

rooms.name: South Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the top of a battlement along the south wall.  There is a commanding
view of all the suroundings toward the south.  Not too far south is the pier
reaching into the harbor.  The walkway leads both east, to the south-east 
corner, and west along the wall.

rooms.name: Corner of Wall Walkway
rooms.desc:
This is the south-east corner of the wall system around Kir Oshi.  From here
you can go down to the ground level, head west along the south wall, or north
along the east wall.

rooms.name: End of the Path
rooms.desc:
The path ends here, with the only exit back from where you came.  Maybe 
someday someone will finish where the path was supposed to go.

rooms.name: A Path Through the Woods
rooms.desc:
This is a fairly new, barely used path leading east west through the woods.  
There is not much to the west of here so you begin to wonder where it leads.

rooms.name: A Path Through the Woods
rooms.desc:
Here is the begining of a fairly new path leading east-west.  It connects to the
pier road just east of here.

rooms.name: Road to the Pier
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a wide paved trade road that connects the city of
Kir Oshi and its main pier.  Towering about you to the north is the great
protective wall of the cetral city.  A small path leads off to the west
from here.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
This the main wooden dock that connects the individual piers to the land and
roads.  To the south is the first pier.  The dock continues east and a road
leads north toward Kir Oshi.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
The main wooden dock continues east and west here.  There is another pier to
the south.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
The main wooden dock continues east and west here.  Yet another pier is to
the south.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
The main wooden dock continues east and west here.  There is also a pier to the
south here.

rooms.name: The Main Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the end of the main dock.  There is a pier to the south here.  The main
pier heads off to the west.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
This is where the harbor meets the port city of Kir-Oshi.
Many vessels are loading and unloading wares on the docks
just east of here. The harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: First Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the first of the five piers that make up the Kir-Oshi
marina.  This is a major trade port, so all the piers are
well equipped for the trade ships and fishing boats that
dock here.  The sounds of a bustling seaport surround you.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
Here, the harbor abuts the piers of Kir-Oshi itself.  The
harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: Second Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the second pier which branches off of the main dock to
extend far out into the harbor, which is just west of you.
Many trade ships unload thier cargo all around you, putting
it on carts bound for the south entrance to the city.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
Here, the harbor abuts the piers of Kir-Oshi itself.  The
harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: Third Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the middle pier that extends from the main dock into
Kir-Oshi harbor, which is just to the west.  The pier is 
clogged with sailors and fishermen, among others, making
transit difficult at best.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
Here, the harbor abuts the piers of Kir-Oshi itself.  The
harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: The Fourth Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the fourth of five piers that make up the Kir-Oshi
waterfront. All the piers seem to be equally busy, and this
one is certainly no exception, you can hardly see through
the throngs of people that are transacting business here.

rooms.name: Kir-Oshi Harbor
rooms.desc:
Here, the harbor abuts the piers of Kir-Oshi itself.  The
harbor extends to the south.

rooms.name: Fifth Pier
rooms.desc:
This is the final pier, furthest from the main road.  It looks
to be the busiest however.  There is a line of carts waiting to
head northwest to the city gates. The harbor is to your west.

rooms.name: An Old Dojo
rooms.desc:
There isn't much to see here, just and empty space that used to
be a martial arts center of some kind.  Its proprietors have 
probably moved on to bigger and better things.
A flight of wooden stairs lead down.

rooms.name: The Kir Oshi Bank
rooms.desc:
You are in a small but neat room where you can conduct your banking buisness.
There does not seem to be anyone here, but the place is spotless, obviously
someone takes care of it.  The only exit is to the east.
